## What's new

### Hidden files are skipped by default

- New **`-a`** flag includes hidden files and folders: `veyra -t image -r -a ~/Pictures`.
- The interactive menu has a new question after you choose images or videos: **"Include hidden files and folders?"** (default: No).
- Hidden means names starting with `.` (like `.git` or `.DS_Store`), files macOS flags as hidden, and files with the Windows Hidden or System attribute.
- Hidden folders are not entered at all, so recursive scans are faster and never read things like `.git`.
- The folder you point veyra at is always scanned, even if its own name starts with a dot.

> **Behavior change:** earlier versions scanned hidden files. Add `-a` (or answer "Yes" in the menu) to get the old behavior.

### Fixes

- Hard links to the same file are now detected on Linux and Windows. Before, they could be listed as separate duplicates.

## Update

- Homebrew: `brew update && brew upgrade veyra`
- macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RishiKendai/veyra/main/install.sh | sh`
- Windows (PowerShell): `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RishiKendai/veyra/main/install.ps1 | iex`

Check with `veyra version`.
